notes.claim: Per cent means per 100, so a percentage counts parts out of every hundred, as 70 per cent means 70 out of every hundred.
To change a percentage to a decimal, divide it by 100; dividing by 100 is the same as multiplying by 0.01.
The decimal multiplier method finds a percentage of an amount by converting the percentage to a decimal and multiplying the amount by it.
10% is a building block: to find 20%, multiply 10% by 2, and to find 5%, divide 10% by 2.
A common mistake with a single-digit percentage is dividing by 10 instead of 100, so 3% is wrongly written as 0.3.
